name: create_media_batch
description: Preview and confirm up to ten exact gallery uploads. Detect repeated source URLs, publish approved items independently, return per-item acceptance/errors and read back the gallery. Never automatically retry unknown outcomes. API acceptance does not imply public visibility. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: capabilities
description: Check actual GBP API access and report supported, restricted, discontinued and manual-only capabilities.

name: list_categories
description: Search official Canadian business categories; never add categories merely for keywords.

name: get_category_types
description: Get full category metadata including eligible structured service IDs and additional hours types.

name: get_google_updates
description: Compare owner-submitted profile with Google's current values, diffMask and pendingMask.

name: find_duplicates
description: Find possible duplicates via accessible accounts and official Google location search. Never merge or delete.

name: list_services
description: Read all structured/custom serviceItems with stable edit keys. Money is a fixed CAD price, never a starting price.

name: get_service_types
description: Retrieve Google-provided service IDs eligible for this profile's current categories.

name: prepare_white5_services
description: Prepare nine requested White5 services without publishing or inventing prices; preserve existing unrelated services.

name: update_services
description: Merge explicitly identified service changes, preserving unrelated entries. Preview current/proposed serviceItems, detect duplicates and stale state, confirm exact preview, then validateOnly or publish and read back. Prices are fixed CAD Money; omit price for variable pricing. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: list_attributes
description: List attributes currently eligible for this location.

name: get_attributes
description: Read current profile attributes.

name: update_attributes
description: Preview eligible typed attribute changes with a narrow attributeMask. Confirm exact preview to publish and read back. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: get_media
description: Get business-owned media metadata. The API exposes no public visibility/moderation approval field.

name: list_customer_media
description: List customer-contributed media with required attribution; no modification of customer media.

name: get_customer_media
description: Read one customer media item preserving attribution.

name: update_media
description: Preview only the supported media category/locationAssociation change; description/source/format edits are not supported. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: delete_media
description: Separately confirm deletion of one business-owned media item. Never deletes customer media or locations. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: check_media_publication
description: Read gallery acceptance evidence and recent uploads; API presence or Google-hosted URLs do not prove public visibility. Compare user-observed count without inventing moderation status.

name: get_post
description: Read an individual local post including the official post state.

name: save_post_draft
description: Save an exact STANDARD/EVENT/OFFER draft privately in White5 after preview confirmation; does not publish. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: list_post_drafts
description: List private White5 post drafts.

name: get_post_draft
description: Read one private White5 post draft.

name: delete_post_draft
description: Delete a private draft after separate confirmation. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: review_summary
description: Paginate reviews; return ratings, counts, unanswered reviews and evidence-based recurring word themes. No fake reviews.

name: suggest_review_reply
description: Prepare an editable reply suggestion grounded in the selected review. Never sends.

name: delete_review_reply
description: Separately confirm deletion of the owner's reply, then read back the review. Cannot delete a customer review. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: search_keywords
description: Get monthly search keyword impressions. Preserve threshold vs exact-count semantics; no invented low-volume counts.

name: compare_performance
description: Compare daily totals and per-day averages across two ranges; call clicks are not completed calls and missing data is not zero.

name: performance_summary
description: Weekly/monthly daily-metric summary, comparison and explicitly heuristic unusual-change flags.

name: list_action_types
description: Discover place action types actually eligible for this location. Do not assume quote/WhatsApp links exist.

name: list_action_links
description: Read current place action links.

name: get_action_link
description: Read one action link and its editable/provider status.

name: create_action_link
description: Preview a link only after verifying the action type is eligible for this location. Confirm exact preview, publish and read back. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: update_action_link
description: Preview URI/preferred changes to a merchant-editable action link. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: delete_action_link
description: Separately confirm removal of one editable action link. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: get_voice_of_merchant
description: Read official Voice of Merchant state, reporting API enablement failures accurately.

name: list_verifications
description: Read paginated verification history.

name: get_verification_options
description: Discover eligible verification methods without starting verification; service-area businesses may need address context.

name: start_verification
description: Owner-approved verification step using only an eligible method/destination. Separate confirmation required; never transfers ownership. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: complete_verification
description: Owner-approved completion of a pending verification using its PIN. PIN is never returned in previews/logs. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: list_admins
description: Read account/location administrators and roles.

name: list_invitations
description: Read pending account invitations.

name: invite_manager
description: Invite a MANAGER only, after exact email preview and separate security confirmation. Owner grants/transfers are not exposed. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: remove_manager
description: Remove only a non-owner MANAGER after separate security confirmation; never removes owners. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: get_notifications
description: Read Google Pub/Sub notification configuration; no Q&A notification types.

name: update_notifications
description: Preview linking an already-provisioned Pub/Sub topic and supported event types. Does not provision IAM/topic/subscription; separate confirmation required. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: poll_changes
description: On-demand polling snapshot of reviews, profile and media. Not real-time; compare with prior stored report when present.

name: run_full_audit
description: Read-only comprehensive GBP audit: completeness, services, attributes, categories, media, reviews, Google changes, performance, keywords and consistency with white5.ca. Recommendations have evidence and no ranking guarantees.

name: schedule_job
description: Preview exact America/Edmonton time and content of an optional job. Only confirmed approved jobs activate alarms. Posts publish once; reports/reminders poll weekly/monthly and are available through list_reports, not email/push. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

runAt.description: Exact ISO timestamp including UTC offset. Display the corresponding America/Edmonton time before approval.

name: list_jobs
description: List approved jobs and their execution states.

name: cancel_job
description: Cancel a future job after preview confirmation. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: list_reports
description: Read stored scheduled reports and polling reminders; no external messages are sent.

name: get_audit_log
description: Read sanitized operation outcomes and scheduled job events; no credentials, signed input URLs or verification PINs.

name: upload_media
description: Accept a user-attached JPEG/PNG or MP4 (up to 75 MiB, 30 seconds, 720p) through ChatGPT file input. With confirmed:true, download and stage it in White5 for 72 hours (10 KB–5 MiB, minimum 250x250). Returns sourceUrl for posts or profile gallery photos. Anyone with this temporary URL can read it. Never publishes to Google. Default is a local preview without downloading. Do not invent file IDs or URLs; ask for an attachment if missing. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: upload_media_batch
description: Stage up to ten user attachments after exact preview approval, with independent per-item success/failure results. Never publishes to Google. JPEG/PNG photos or supported MP4 video. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: create_media
description: Preview adding a photo to the Google Business Profile gallery from sourceUrl (including upload_media output). confirmed:true publishes after explicit approval of the exact photo, category and description. COVER/PROFILE changes the profile's cover/profile photo. Google may moderate publication. Does not create a local post. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: list_media
description: List existing Google Business Profile gallery media with pagination. Read only; Google API availability and location permissions still apply.

name: connection_status
description: Refreshes Google authorization and checks accounts. With account/location (or saved primary), checks location, posts, reviews and performance separately; reports actual API restrictions.

name: list_accounts
description: List accessible Google Business Profile accounts, with pagination.

name: list_locations
description: List Business Profile locations including business details, service area and Voice of Merchant status. Follow nextPageToken to find duplicates.

name: get_location
description: Read business name, address/service area, phones, website, hours, metadata and profile status.

name: list_reviews
description: Read location reviews, ratings and total review count. Requires Google My Business API access.

name: get_review
description: Read an individual Google Business Profile review.

name: list_posts
description: Read local posts. Requires Google My Business API access.

name: prepare_post
description: Validate and prepare a local STANDARD/EVENT/OFFER post draft with text, photo URLs and call-to-action/website links. No network calls or Google draft is created.

name: create_post
description: Preview a STANDARD/EVENT/OFFER post by default; confirmed:true publishes after explicit user approval. No server-side draft or validateOnly API exists for posts. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: update_post
description: Preview post changes by default; confirmed:true applies only supplied fields after explicit user approval. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: delete_post
description: Preview deletion of one local post; confirmed:true deletes only after explicit user approval. Never deletes business profiles. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: reply_to_review
description: Validate and preview a review reply; confirmed:true sends only after explicit user approval of the exact text. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: update_location
description: Preview validated business information changes. confirmed:true with validateOnly:true validates at Google without mutation; validateOnly:false applies after explicit approval. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.

name: get_performance
description: Read daily Search/Maps impressions, website clicks, call clicks (not completed calls), directions and other supported metrics. Unavailable access returns an explicit capability error.

name: get_location_permissions
description: Read location administrators and Voice of Merchant verification state. Each capability reports its own availability.

name: set_primary_location
description: Validate an accessible White5 location with Voice of Merchant and save its account/location in private Worker KV only after explicit confirmation. Does not change the Google listing. First prepare a preview; confirmed:true MUST include its previewId and identical arguments. Changed/expired previews are rejected. Destructive operations also require the exact separate confirmation phrase.
